text: Implemented typed normalized coefficient covariance result payloads. Added CoefficientCovarianceScope and CoefficientCovariance for shared vs voxelwise covariance; threaded explicit covariance payloads through OLS, GLS, robust, dense block merge, DenseFmriFitResult, and InferenceReadyDenseFit. Voxelwise GLS now preserves one covariance matrix per selected voxel through chunked merge, and named T/F contrasts use the voxel-specific matrix. ResultManifest now includes CoefficientCovarianceArtifact with parameter names, selected voxels, shape, provenance, and export intent. Tests cover direct voxelwise T/F inference, voxelwise GLS inference, future chunked voxelwise AR merge, artifact preservation/mismatch rejection, and ImageMaps compatibility. Evidence: sbt fitJVM/test passed 118 warning-clean; sbt modelJVM/test passed 16; sbt modelJS/test passed 16; sbt fitJS/test passed 115; scoped git diff --check clean; trailing-whitespace scan clean. Remaining: actual JVM writer adapters for NIfTI/HDF5/GDS/BIDS-style exports and compressed reduced-rank covariance/backends.
